title: wg: draft-mahy-mimi-credential-preauth-00 internal inconsistencies (for when it is revised)
description:
From assay mimid-1wgh.44.10 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-credential-preauth-00.txt. Low priority: the draft is an early WIP. Posting needs Mark's OK.

1. Three names for the pointer item kinds: examples use via_key / via_array_search (e.g. L453, L517); ClaimItemType has member_name/array_position (L864); ItemType has map_key/array_search/any (L890); JwtToken uses JwtItemType and array_index (L876-880). Pick one.
2. Family names: ClaimFamily is x509/jwt/cwt but MapKey and FoundValue select on json/cbor/asn1 (L979, L996).
3. OperationType skips 5-6, has no (255), and the Operation select uses 'ends_width' (L958) for ends_with; optional<uint> (L957-962) is not a TLS type.
4. Examples vs syntax: §5.5 says it compares eur_per_hour but points at 'processor' (L659 vs L687); §5.3 searches 'DCBA-10177' in a document holding 'DCBA-101777' (L405 vs L494, L515), so as written it finds nothing; §5.6 uses match_as=scheme (L754) and §5.7 'uripath' (L770), neither in MatchAs; 'array_serach' (L1313).
5. No rule for what a pointer returns on a type mismatch at a level, or how 'exists' interacts with no match (requirement 1, §4).
6. §7 TODO; §8 X.509 examples empty; §9 is old text; reference is room-policy-03 (L1485; -04 is current).
